digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service initialization and operation snapshot composition
propositions: Static deployment policy and non-secret provider bindings must be composed once at MCP/review-bot service startup and frozen for the process lifetime, while operation-scoped configuration and request context auth remain transient.
Inbound MCP bearer tokens and OAuth material must remain request-local via context variables, never enter startup/operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, child processes, or tool schemas.

Review-bot decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub credentials) must be validated before accepting work or webhook jobs with no fallback to alternative principals, and the composed LLMRuntime must be forwarded through code review operations.
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must fail open without affecting operation results or security auth, which remains fail-closed.
Static binding changes (environment/file mutations) are observed only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned credential refresh remains SDK-managed.
MCP per-call load_config ambient reads must be eliminated to enforce composition ownership and prevent inconsistent config/auth re-reads during operation execution.
